title: Sistema Carrillo - Mafia Maps 2000
credits: Sistema Carrillo, Q. Roo, Mexico; surveyed passage to date 6,293 feet; exploration and survey Christophe Le Maillot, Fred Devos; Mafia Maps, September 2000 (c) F. Devos 2000
unverified: No cenote of the map has a position: the eight caves of the sistema in the database (Cow Dump, Turtle Dump, Pajaro, Ojo Rojo, Chan Pek, Chupa Hoop, Choco Pol, Air Bell; all Gerrard 2015, area Puerto Aventuras) have none, the sistema has none, none of their names is in OpenStreetMap (Overpass search 20.30-20.65 N, 87.10-87.45 W) or found on the web, and the map draws no road, coast line or pond to match - only the word BEACH south-east of the cave. The single control point is a NOMINAL anchor (Cenote Pajaro put on Puerto Aventuras, 20.5003 N, 87.2309 W) so the pipeline can run: the geometry is NOT on the ground. To fix: field GPS positions of two of its cenotes (Pajaro and Choco Pol are about 690 m apart at the derived scale, at the two ends).
placementWhy: UNVERIFIED (see 'unverified'). No scale bar: the scale, 0.643 m/px, comes from the title block's 'Surveyed passage to date: 6,293 feet' (1,918 m) over the traced lines' length (about 2,985 px) - assumes the whole surveyed length is drawn (Mafia line plots are smoothed: the real scale is likely a little smaller). North from the compass rose (up), unchecked. Position nominal. No placed map can overlap it, since its position is unknown.

trace.why: Stick map (Mafia Maps line plot, black guidelines only, no walls): traced as lines, no thickness. Cenote pools (filled blobs), dots, depths, labels and the two dashed flow arrows are masked. The Chan Pek box stops short of the line running along the pool's east edge. Gaps kept as drawn (jumps): Air Belle's dot and the west spur's end (391, 1017)-(392, 1028); Chupa Hoop's pool isn't joined to the line.
